prompt: Which U.S. airline had the highest percentage of delayed flights over the full calendar year of 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Transportation's Air Travel Consumer Report?
answer: **Frontier Airlines** had the highest share of delayed flights in 2024. It had the lowest annual on-time arrival rate among the reporting marketing carriers—about **72% on time**, meaning roughly **28% of its operated flights arrived late** (15 minutes or more).
